To fit fuel injection pump gear
1.   Where necessary, fit dowel to fuel injection
     pump gear.
2.   Fit gear. Ensure dowel is in correct location be­
     tween gear and fuel injection pump.
3.   Fit and tighten washers and setscrews or nut.
     Tighten nut to the torque given on page C3.
4.   Fit idler gear. Ensure all timing marks align.

    To check DPA fuel injection pump timing
    by use of pump rotor marks
    A circlip is fitted inside the fuel injection pump and
    when the square end of this circlip is aligned with
    the correct mark on the fuel pump rotor (see fig.
    L3), it indicates when the injection starts to No. 1
    cylinder (static timing point).
